answer: At the wharf the cargo is weighed hold by hold and the manifest is sealed before the barge casts off. A inlet load claimed as carried fails the manifest: the scales must have weighed it at the falcon of the loading, and a load never carried has no weight to declare. Forging a season of manifests means hiring a wharfinger, faking seventy weighings and paying 13,300, while the crystal manifest is read at every lock the barge passes, so cargo whose weighing was never sealed is unloaded on the spot.
